profile_text.body:
n8n is a workflow automation platform that describes itself as combining AI capabilities with business process automation, giving technical teams what it calls the flexibility of code alongside the speed of no-code. The platform supports multi-agent setups, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and integration with both cloud-hosted and offline AI models, as well as legacy systems. It also advertises Model Context Protocol support and features for enforcing structured inputs and outputs to control data flow to and from AI steps.

The core product, also called n8n, is categorized as an automation and agents tool supporting workflow automation and agentic actions. The platform allows users to combine human-in-the-loop approvals with rule-based automation, and accommodates both low-code configuration and custom code nodes for more complex workflows. The site positions it as suitable for teams that want to integrate AI into existing processes in a controlled way.

The held facts on file include no litigation, no MCP server registrations, and no SEC or patent filings. n8n has an existing page on theworldofai.org tied to its primary product listing.
